results.title: Frontiers | A survey on deep learning in medical ultrasound imaging
results.content: Multi-Sensor Imaging and Fusion: Methods, Evaluations, and Applications, volume II. # A survey on deep learning in medical ultrasound imaging. With its non-invasive, low-cost advantages, this technology has been widely used in medicine and there have been many significant breakthroughs in ultrasound imaging. As artificial intelligence technology advances, some researchers have initiated efforts to deploy deep learning to address challenges in ultrasound imaging, such as reducing computational complexity in adaptive beamforming and aiding novices in image acquisition. In this survey, we are about to explore the application of deep learning in medical ultrasound imaging, spanning from image reconstruction to clinical diagnosis. The integration of deep learning with medical imaging has spurred advancements, with the potential to reshape clinical practices and healthcare delivery. At the same time, many applications of deep learning in clinics have emerged [10–16]. The medical ultrasound system mainly includes image reconstruction and image analysis, both of which have seen extensive applications of deep learning [26].
